title: Sage 2D primitive option fidelity
objective: Implement Sage-compatible line, point, polygon, arrow, and text option semantics with explicit unsupported-option errors, correct z-order lowering, deterministic Sage 10.9 differential fixtures, and representative performance coverage

oracles: SageMath 10.9 primitive option dictionaries and rendered primitive semantics

handoff.summary: Implemented Sage-compatible line, point, polygon, arrow, and text render plans and Plotly lowering; imported and stabilized curve correctness; added differential oracles, focused compiled tests, and performance benchmarks. The native flat-coordinate materializer reduces 100k curve PlotSpec construction from seconds to about 0.27 seconds.
risks: Annotation-only arrows and styled text deliberately reject non-default zorder because Plotly annotations cannot preserve trace z-layer semantics.
TeX path markers, text bounding_box, and text clip=True are explicit unsupported errors rather than silent losses.
The final opacity-to-alpha presentation alias is source-formatted and narrowly additive; root should include it in the post-integration build run.
next_steps: Add strict pyright entries for sage_primitives2d.py, curve_sampling.py, sage_curves.py, and the six sage.plot wrapper modules.
Export intended public planning helpers from sagejs.plotting.__init__ and own the sage.plot wrapper exports centrally.
Register graphics-primitives2d.cjs and graphics-curve-semantics.cjs in the node test manifest.
Confirm the integrated graphics bootstrap budget remains at least 400000 bytes.
Regenerate plotting coverage/frontend surface artifacts after public exports are finalized.
